editorial:
Imagine running into an old school friend who used to be the class outcast, only to find out they have turned into a total knockout. That is exactly what happens to Kosuke, a regular salesman who reconnects with Mao. The vibe is very sweet and romantic at first, making you feel like you are watching a classic love story. You will really root for them as they fall head over heels and start planning a life together. It feels like a warm hug of a movie, but there is a strange feeling in the air that tells you something is not quite right with Mao.

What really makes this work is how the mystery unfolds slowly. The acting is natural, and the chemistry between the leads is great. While the pacing starts slow, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories that mix love with a bit of a supernatural twist, you will love this.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that Mao actually died years ago. She is a ghost who stayed behind because she loved Kosuke. The twist is that she has been using her powers to stay visible, but she cannot stay in the human world forever. In the end, she has to say a heartbreaking goodbye to Kosuke so she can finally move on. It is a sad but beautiful conclusion that shows true love lasts beyond death.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic dramas with a sad twist.
